recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-6044.
issue_request: FHIR-6044 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire change request from DSTU1 asking to add Questionnaire.subjectType 0..* bound to the list of resource types so Questionnaire could declare the allowed subject types for QuestionnaireAnswers/QuestionnaireResponse.subject.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied in SVN r5941, imported as git commit 26e8b597d5034f4372a848e5660a88268f4b664c, whose message lists {#6044} and whose patch added subjectType values to Questionnaire examples and updated the then-authoritative Questionnaire spreadsheet. Later refactors converted that spreadsheet-backed definition into source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml while preserving the element.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml current build input. FHIR-11004 later clarified the QuestionnaireResponse.subject side of the same rule and is already represented on the combined branch. FHIR-27844 is an SDC profile issue that confirms an absent subjectType means no subject-type restriction; it is consistent with current core semantics but belongs outside the core checkout.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Questionnaire source defines Questionnaire.subjectType with min 0, max *, type code, a required binding to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/resource-types, and the comment that if none are specified the subject is unlimited. QuestionnaireResponse.subject also says a declared Questionnaire.subjectType restricts the response subject to the listed types.

related_jiras.note: Later FHIR-core clarification of Questionnaire.subjectType versus QuestionnaireResponse.subject; already audited on the combined branch and current source includes the clarified rule.
FHIR-sdc profile cardinality discussion confirming missing subjectType means unrestricted; supports leaving core 0..* semantics unchanged.
